• read_field(): pull-based read for run_target only
• subscribe(): registers a callback against the external monitor
notification capability and returns true once that
registration succeeds (false if this source has no
event-driven path available); on each callback invocation the
adapter builds one immutable snapshot of the full payload
(originating from PHM via LM) and atomically swaps it in;
read_field() calls within one collection cycle all resolve
against that same snapshot, never mixing two event generations
• This is the ONLY class a future module needs to write
• INTERNAL class of the Launch Manager daemon
• NOT part of the public ILmControl interface, NOT exposed via
mw::com, and NOT reachable by an external VEL process
• Shown here ONLY to document the origin/type of state and pid --
VEL does NOT call these getters directly
• Payload type delivered by the external monitor notification
• process_name/process_group_name identify WHICH process a given
notification is about: the callback is registered ONCE per
LifecycleFieldBindings instance (not once per process), so each
notification must self-identify its subject for the adapter to
route it to the correct resource_id
• Originates from Platform Health Monitor (PHM) for the fields PHM
evaluates; delivered to LifecycleFieldBindings via Launch
